behaviors.description: Load the original rigged Prismals GLB with its indexed geometry, UVs, four-joint influences and inverse-bind skeleton.
behaviors.selection: The planet application prepares the model before its first navigation presentation.

checks.expectation: The model loads without substituting geometry or art; malformed or unsupported data fails explicitly.
checks.procedure: Review GLB chunk/accessor bounds, joint parent cycles, bind-matrix inversion and skin normalization. Inspect the imported model and compare the asset SHA256 to provenance.
